title: Doukoku Soshite...
overview:
Help... someone... save me...

Doukoku Soshite is a point-and-click horror adventure. After a bus accident, the hero and his classmates wake up trapped inside an abandoned mansion. Deadly traps have been laid for them throughout the house, and they must find a way out alive.

Explore the mansion, gather items and use them to get past each trap. How you deal with the traps shapes the story, which branches toward multiple endings, and saving every girl may take more than one attempt. The voice cast includes Miki Nagasawa, Tsumugi Osawa, Yuriko Yamaguchi, Takehito Koyasu and Koichi Kitamura.

- Shuttle Mouse supported
- Includes a bonus mini drama CD

助けて誰か…私を…
